note: Bridger-Teton NF, about 20 mi S of Afton on the south side of Salt River Pass, up a short gravel road (FSR 10131) off US-89. Spurs in pine and aspen beside the willows of Little White Creek, with beaver ponds nearby. The hand-pump water is not potable. --Claude
summary: FS page current; no rec.gov campground (group picnic site only), first-come confirmed. $10, 2 vehicles max, 32 sites, vault toilets, non-potable hand pumps. Not waterfront stands. Pin ~480 m S of the loops at the highway -> 42.4898,-110.9619. Phone empty -> 307-828-5100.
flags: PIN: stored 42.4855,-110.9625 is in the trees just W of the US-89 turn-off; the campground's spur road runs ~500 m N past the group picnic loop to the campsite spurs at ~42.4898,-110.9619 (seen on imagery) - ~480 m. Move to 42.4898,-110.9619.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands: Little White Creek is a 2-3 m stream in a willow band along the east edge; the eastern spurs are ~30 m from it through conifers and willows, and the beaver ponds are SE across US-89. The FS 'adjacent to Little White Creek' does not earn creekside (willow screen). Stored evidence was read at the wrong pin, but the call holds at the loops.
SEASON: the FS page gives both 'Seasons of Use: May 1st weather permitting' and 'usually open around Memorial Day if snow allows, until the snow falls in the late fall'; no season written.
PHONE: empty -> 307-828-5100 (FS contact, Kemmerer Ranger District).
WEBSITE current: FS r04 page 200. No rec.gov listing for the campground.
